sub2: We just claimed ours. Here's what it does.

items.title: Claim your business in ChatGPT
items.why: Search for your business at chatgpt.com/business-hub, then verify it by text, phone call or DNS.

items.title: Keep your details accurate
items.why: Update your products and services so ChatGPT describes your business the way you would.

items.title: See how people find you
items.why: Track mentions, profile views, website clicks and the topics where ChatGPT cites your site.

items.title: Business agents are coming
items.why: Customers will be able to ask your business questions right in ChatGPT. Starting with eligible U.S. e-commerce and online service businesses.
